1253160778749837314.a: Speaking of #makers #making things while stuck at home... I didn't make this potato bin but I did make it a bit more useful. Fun project. I replaced the bottom and window, lined the inside, refinished the wood, and made a chalkboard and ledge to record when things are added. t.co

1253162339727179776.a:
The artwork is from Pixabay. Vinyl was cut on a Cricut Explore. Acrylic window was scrap. The inside is finished with polyurethane with a vinyl bottom and the outside is varnished. Hinges are hand painted with acrylic and the pull is almond spray paint.

pixabay.com/vectors/vegeta…

1253162341128196099.a: The chalkboard is Rust-Oleum chalkboard paint. The ledge is a piece of window trim that has a groove routed in it. Inside the groove is walnut stained balsa wood. Everything is varnished on the outside except the chalkboard and acrylic.
